opex.text: Other expenses increased $19 million or 4% and $66 million or 7% in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 when compared to the same period in 2025 driven by increases in general operating expenses and salaries and benefits expense due to growth in receivables and our strategic investments in the business, as well as restructuring charges in the current period not present in the prior period. The increase was partially offset by a decrease in insurance policy benefits and claims expense due to the benefit of a reserve release.

costs.text: Other expenses increased $19 million or 4% and $66 million or 7% in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 when compared to the same period in 2025 driven by increases in general operating expenses and salaries and benefits expense due to growth in receivables and our strategic investments in the business, as well as restructuring charges in the current period not present in the prior period. The increase was partially offset by a decrease in insurance policy benefits and claims expense due to the benefit of a reserve release.

other_opex.text: At June 30, 2026, we had $567 million of cash and cash equivalents, which included $171 million of cash and cash equivalents held at our regulated insurance subsidiaries or for other operating activities that is unavailable for general corporate purposes.

prov.text: We monitor delinquency trends to evaluate the risk of future credit losses and employ advanced analytical tools to manage performance. Team members are actively engaged in collection activities throughout the early stages of delinquency. We closely track and report the percentage of receivables that are contractually 30-89 days past due as a benchmark of portfolio quality, collections effectiveness, and as a strong indicator of losses in coming quarters.

nonint.text: Other expenses increased $19 million or 4% and $66 million or 7% in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 when compared to the same period in 2025 driven by increases in general operating expenses and salaries and benefits expense due to growth in receivables and our strategic investments in the business, as well as restructuring charges in the current period not present in the prior period. The increase was partially offset by a decrease in insurance policy benefits and claims expense due to the benefit of a reserve release.

nonop.text: Interest expense increased $9 million or 3% and $20 million or 3% in the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 when compared to the same period in 2025 due to an increase in average debt to support our receivables growth.

pretax.text: OMH’s reconciliations of Income before income tax expense on a Segment Accounting Basis to C&I Adjusted pretax income (non-GAAP) and Pretax capital generation (non-GAAP) were as follows:

tax.text: Income taxes decreased $3 million or 7% for the three months ended June 30, 2026 when compared to the same period in 2025 due to lower pretax income. Income taxes increased $5 million or 4% in the six months ended June 30, 2026 when compared to the same period in 2025 due to timing of federal tax credits purchased in the prior year period.

net.text: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, OMH generated net income of $378 million. OMH’s net cash inflow from operating and investing activities totaled $50 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. At June 30, 2026, our scheduled interest payments for the remainder of 2026 totaled $340 million and there were no scheduled principal payments for 2026 on our existing unsecured debt. As of June 30, 2026, we had $11.6 billion of unencumbered receivables.

ocf.text: Net cash provided by operations of $1.5 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026 reflected net income of $378 million, the impact of non-cash items including provision for finance receivable losses of $1.1 billion, and an unfavorable change in working capital of $56 million. intro.text: OneMain Financial (NYSE: OMF) is the leader in offering nonprime consumers responsible access to credit and is dedicated to improving the financial well-being of hardworking Americans. We empower our customers to solve today’s problems and reach a better financial future through personalized solutions across 48 states, available online and in more than 1,300 locations. OneMain is committed to making a positive impact on the people and the communities we serve. For additional information, please visit www.OneMainFinancial.com.

lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
